description: This Java class defines a 'DeviceCommunicationSucceededEvent' that extends the 'Event' class. It encapsulates information about a successful device communication event, specifically storing an EUI-64 identifier and providing a getter method for it.

classes.name: DeviceCommunicationSucceededEvent
classes.description: Represents an event indicating successful communication with a device, identified by its EUI-64 address.

methods.name: DeviceCommunicationSucceededEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with an EUI-64 string and sets the event name.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI-64 identifier associated with this event.
